jobs.description:
Do you love working with the newest technology and gadgets? Get started as a Warehouse Operator in a high-tech warehouse! At Arrow Electronics you have the choice to work between 24 - 30 hours per week. 4 or 5 workdays, you choose! You will earn a top salary of up to € 19.50 per hour! And do you like to stay fit? Then you can use the free gym inside the Arrow building! Does this sound like the perfect job? Read more below! 👇

What we offer
- Earn a salary of € 15.00 per hour!
- Working after 20:00 = 30% shift bonus!
- Travel and holiday allowance!
- Weekly payment!
- A diverse and international workplace
- Free on-site gym access!

Who you are
As a Warehouse Operator at Arrow you are a motivated, hands-on star who thrives on speed! You are comfortable standing for the duration of your shift. You also need to meet the following requirements:

- You speak Dutch, English or German.
- You are available to work 4 or 5 days a week between Monday and Friday.
- You are available to work 6 hours a day in a 2-shift system (06.00-12.45 and 15.15-22.00)
- You have your own transportation to get to the Venlo area.
- You are looking for long-term job.

What will you do
At Arrow, you work with all kinds of cool electronic products for customers across Europe. On your first day as a Warehouse Operator, a buddy will help you learn everything, how great is that! For this job, you'll be responsible for the Picking department of Arrow Electronics. You work at a fixed spot and the products come to you automatically. Your tasks include:

- Stationary order picking
- Conveyor belt sorting
- Manage automated bin routing
- Ensure timely delivery

Where will you work
Arrow Electronics is a world leader in technology. You will work as a Warehouse Operator in a brand-new, modern warehouse! The location is in Greenport Venlo. It is easy to reach by car with free parking! This building is a fantastic place to work! You can enjoy fresh hot meals in the large cafeteria or relax with colleagues
